Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in a Dubai Desert Safari?
Standard evening safaris include 4x4 hotel pickup, 35–45 minutes of red dune bashing in Lahbab, sandboarding, camel rides, live shows (Belly dance, Tanoura, Fire show), and a 5-star international BBQ dinner buffet with vegetarian and non-vegetarian menus.
Do I need a driving license to rent a quad bike or dune buggy?
No driver's license is required. All self-drive quad bikes and dune buggies operate on dedicated desert trails under the supervision of trained marshals. Safety equipment (helmets & goggles) is provided.
How does payment work?
We offer Pay on Arrival. You do not need to pay or provide a credit card online—simply pay in cash or card when you arrive or meet your driver.
